items.title: The no-sleep issue is just another confusing part of the Jalen Hurts story
items.text: The absence of complete information about the events that led to Eagles quarterback Jalen Hurts traveling to London with a blood clot in his leg, playing with a blood clot in his leg, and promptly traveling back to Philadelphia with a blood clot in his leg has resulted in plenty of reports aimed at filling the gaps.

items.title: What's next for Dan Quinn?
items.text: At the end of the first half of Monday night's game, with the Commanders down 20-3 and coach Dan Quinn going viral based on a lip-reading clip that was being widely interpreted as him not realizing it was fourth down (after a failed fourth-down play), it looked like Quinn was on track to get fired after the game.

items.title: Dan Quinn's fourth-down explanation exposes a different failure of attention to detail
items.text: After Monday night's game, Commanders coach Dan Quinn took his time in showing up to talk to reporters.

items.title: Josh Jacobs to get full week of practice, game status to be determined

items.title: Brock Purdy is the NFL's all-time record holder for highest career passer rating
items.text: The NFL has a new all-time record holder for highest career passer rating: Brock Purdy.
